## pragmas
pragma	gml	10gml	#pragma gml <version> (file level)
pragma	init	10init	#pragma init (file level)
pragma	include	10include	#pragma include <path> (file level)
pragma	preload	10preload	#pragma preload <file> (file level)
pragma	using	10using	#pragma using <mod.type[.ext]> (file level)
pragma	fast_file	10fast_file	#pragma fast_file (file level)
pragma	fast	10fast	#pragma fast (statement)
pragma	not_fast	10not_fast	#pragma not_fast (statement)
pragma	no_using	10no_using	#pragma no_using (statement)
